{{Quote|It doesn't matter how good the plan is if it isn't executed well.|Coret Bhan|<ref name="Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Leadership}}</ref>}}
'''Coret Bhan''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a former [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] in a harsh [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region. He had a strong hatred of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and became a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was an intense fighter who led by example.

==Biography==
===Battle of Talus===
{{Quote|Take them out! They're nothing but cadets in this academy!|Coret Bhan|<ref name="Squadrons Over Corellia">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:Coret_Bhan_-_SWGTCG.jpg|left|thumb|Bhan leads an assault on the Imperial base on Talus.]]
Shortly before the [[battle of Talus]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Bhan led a hit-and-run [[attack on the Raithal Academy]]. A Rebel strike force has landed just outside the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and&mdash;without trying to capture or destroy it&mdash;tried to disrupt Imperial planning in preparation for the operation in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. When the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of Academy put up reasonable defense, Rebel forces fell back in good order towards their landing craft, leaving behind some explosives which they planned to use to blow the starport on their way out.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

Later, when the initial Imperial assault on the [[Talus base]] had failed, Bhan led a Rebel counterattack at the Imperial outpost on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. The Rebel attack force consisted of Rebel commandos, supported by heavy troopers and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] bombers. All available Imperial soldiers rushed to defend the outpost, and eventually began to make headway against the Rebels. As this was yet another strike-and-fade operation, planned to disrupt Imperial operations, Bhan gave the order for the Alliance forces to fall back. The Rebels quickly escaped back to their base, while the Imperials were in no shape to pursue them.<ref name="DS" />

===Capture===
{{Quote|Must be something important in that outpost if they hired these assassins to guard it.|Coret Bhan|<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:Coret_Bhan_-_GH.jpg|right|thumb|Coret Bhan in action]]
Following the battle of Talus, the Zabrak's career was rising. Bhan's field command skills were so valuable that the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] refused to promote him to a desk job. Bhan held the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]] longer than anyone else in the Alliance. The fact attracted the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Bhan's name was put onto [[Emperor's Most Wanted]], a list of high-paid bounties on critical Alliance leaders. Two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] cooperated to capture Bhan; one of them was [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], who had obtained Bhan's deployment orders from a Rebel courier. Bhan was going to lead a strike-and-fade operation on an Imperial outpost on Dantooine. The bounty hunters decided to ambush him in the field, despite knowing that Bhan would be surrounded by veteran commandos. When the Rebel strike team reached the rough terrain surrounding the outpost, the Rebels were forced to cover the last kilometers on foot. As Bhan led the commandos into a clearing, [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] activated the trip wires which set off [[flechette mine]]s and [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke bombs]] placed by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. While the Rebels were confused, the bounty hunters launched their attack. The ambush worked perfectly, and soon the Rebels were forced to surrender. Bhan ordered his men to stand down, while IG-88 put him in binders and prepared to deliver him to the Imperial authorities.<ref name="Galactic Hunters" />

The temporary holding place for the captured Rebels was the Imperial prison facility in a rough mountain area just outside [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Bhan was handed over to the Empire, but the Rebel agents learned the location of the facility and launched a bold raid in an attempt to rescue the prisoners. Despite heavy resistance from the Imperial forces, the Rebels gained the upper hand and evacuated the rescued prisoners, including Bhan, to safety.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

===Further activities===
{{Quote|I don't deal with scum like you.|Coret Bhan|<ref name="Agents of Deception">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:CoretBhan-AoD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bhan on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
When a large shipment of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] went missing on its way to Alliance medical facility, several Rebel operatives were dispatched to track it down. Bhan, along with several Rebel commandos, was supposed to meet with [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] Major [[Alana Walden]] at the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], but while waiting for their contact to arrive, the Rebels were confronted by a band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] trying to leave the spaceport. The Rebels had no choice but to fight, and eventually kill them all. After the skirmish many were tired and wounded, but were given no chance to rest. An [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) agent stepped around the corner and, after announcing that he had left Major Walden bleeding in a nearby alley, demanded from Bhan the information about the ryll shipment. Bhan's response was delivered with a blaster bolt, and his commandos had joined him, though they were weakened from the previous firefight. Soon, several of Bhan's men were killed and the rest were in no shape to fight. The Imperial got no information from Bhan, though a young wounded [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] accidentally mentioned that Bhan was supposed to meet with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on Corellia. The ISB agent jokingly saluted the wounded Rebels and departed, while they were too weak to do anything about it.<ref name="Agents of Deception" />

While Bhan did not approve of such activities, as a Rebel officer he often had to deal with smugglers.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Rebel Sympathizer">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Rebel Sympathizer}}</ref> On the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], Bhan was supposed to meet with [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], a smuggler, who transported valuable cargo for the Alliance, using the swoop racing to cover his movements. Bhan received a small package from Rendar behind a grandstand and prepared to leave, when he was suddenly confronted by an ISB agent. His combat skills gave him the upper hand over the Imperial, forcing the latter to retreat and to report Bhan's involvement to his superiors.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>
